# bifrost_environment (Resource)

Un entorno de una App (su propio namespace `app-<app>-<entorno>`, cuota y red cerrada). Destruir lo archiva; `on_destroy = "purge"` lo elimina (solo un administrador; exige retención cumplida y sin herramientas).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bifrost_environment" "dev" {
  app  = bifrost_app.tienda.name
  name = "dev"
  quota = {
    cpu    = "1"
    memory = "2Gi"
    pods   = 10
    pvcs   = 2
  }
}

# El entorno que la API crea junto con la App se adopta:
resource "bifrost_environment" "prod" {
  app            = bifrost_app.tienda.name
  name           = "prod"
  adopt_existing = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Nombre de la App.
- `name` (String) Nombre del entorno (slug, 2 a 16).

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Si el entorno ya existe (p. ej. el que la API crea junto con la App), adoptarlo en vez de fallar con 409. Si indicas `quota`, debe coincidir con la real.
- `on_destroy` (String) `archive` (por omisión) o `purge` (eliminación definitiva e irreversible).
- `quota` (Attributes) Cuota del entorno. Sin indicarla hereda la cuota por omisión de la App. **No se puede cambiar después de crear el entorno** (la API no tiene esa operación). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quota))
- `restore_archived` (Boolean) Si existe archivado, restaurarlo en vez de fallar con 409.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace de Kubernetes del entorno.
- `status` (String) `active`, `provisioning`, `error` o `archived`.

<a id="nestedatt--quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quota`

Required:

- `cpu` (String) Núcleos solicitados, ej. `2` o `500m`.
- `memory` (String) Memoria solicitada, ej. `4Gi`.
- `pods` (Number) Máximo de pods (1 a 500).
- `pvcs` (Number) Máximo de volúmenes persistentes (0 a 100).


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import bifrost_environment.dev tienda/dev
```
